insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Addasound delivered $405 in total sales for Week 46, up 118.2% from $186 the prior week, on 40 units. The Epic 302 USB Headset grew to $146 (+185.0%) with an 11.1% conversion rate, and the Epic 501 ($129, 13 units) and Crystal SR2831 ($79, 13 units) both added meaningful volume. Wednesday, Nov 11 was the peak day at $209.

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales were concentrated in the second half of the week, with $0 recorded Sunday, Nov 8 through Tuesday, Nov 10. PPC revenue came in at $103 (-47.0%) and the Crystal 2732 QD Headset eased to $49 (-17.0%) on 28 sessions, so building consistent daily demand is the focus.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Ad spend of $305 (prior $323) returned $103 in PPC revenue, a 0.34x ROAS at a 296.6% ACOS. TACoS improved to 75.3% from 173.80% as total sales grew, and ad CTR was a healthy 0.63%, while the 0.53% ad conversion rate shows more clicks need to turn into orders.

**Actions This Week —** We will pause or lower bids on non-converting search terms and refocus spend on the Epic 302, Epic 501 and Crystal SR2831, which converted at 11.1%, 19.7% and 30.2%. Building on the 0.63% ad CTR, we will tighten targeting to lift ad conversion above 0.53% and bring ACOS down from 296.6% heading into the holiday season.
